IS 5405 : 2025 Disposable Sanitary Napkin/Panty Liner/Maternity Pad/Period Panty - Specification
ICS 59.080
ICS 59.080
TXD 36
TXD 36
1 SCOPE
This standard covers the requirements for disposable (non-reusable) sanitary napkin/pantyliner/maternity pad/period panty for external use.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards.
